name: CSG Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: CSG Holding Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells glass products in Mainland and internationally. It operates through Glass, Electronic Glass and Display device, and Solar Energy and Other segments. The Glass segment engages in the production and sale of float, photovoltaic, and engineering glass products; and silica sand for glass production. It also offers architectural, solar, photovoltaic, and float glasses for applications in high-end architectural curtain walls, decoration and furniture, mirror, car windshield, scanners and photocopiers transmitting plates, home appliance panels, display protection, and other fields.
